inspection_spans.observation: Correct intent and tool selection can still yield non-executable calls when parameter values use the user's language rather than the interface convention.
Execution-interface violations dominate for some languages; translation mitigations help but introduce semantic drift and do not recover English performance.
The study is single-turn, uses three languages and an English-parameter interface, and treats mitigations as diagnostic probes.
